audience: customer experience teams that analyse survey answers in Survicate

useCases.title: Compare response counts across surveys
useCases.text: List the surveys, newest first, with their type. Then list the responses of one survey in a time range.

useCases.title: Read the answers to one question
useCases.text: List the questions of a survey to map question ids to their possible answers. Then list the responses filtered by a respondent attribute.

useCases.title: Review one respondent's history
useCases.text: Read every response one respondent gave, across all surveys. Then read the attributes of that respondent, including those synced from integrations.

useCases.title: Open one response in full
useCases.text: Get the survey to see the attribute names it sends. Then get one response with its answers, device and language.
